notes: Validated against Klein & Ferré-D'Amaré Science 2006 (doi:10.1126/science.1129666) and Cochrane et al. 2007. GlcN6P is a RIBOZYME COFACTOR not a classical riboswitch ligand — it positions the 2′-OH for self-cleavage of the scissile phosphate at G1. CRITICAL CONTACTS: C2-amine of GlcN6P H-bonds the leaving group G1 5′-O; also H-bonds U43 O4. C1-OH H-bonds G57 N1 in the minor groove. 6-Phosphate H-bonds G1 N1 and backbone atoms. G1 N1 is directly involved in the cleavage reaction (general acid). Both RNA chains (A+B) contribute to the active site in 3B4B. CALIBRATION NOTES: baseStacking removed from interactionKinds (2026-06-03) because GlcN6P has no aromatic ring. Primary literature interactions are H-bonds not yet scored by MacVina aptamer terms. phosphateElectrostatic is the only scorable term. Used as negative control for baseStacking term specificity.
